text.us: Polls close in the US midterms, with record turnout in Florida, Georgia, Michigan and North Carolina and a focus on the candidates who could decide them. Donald Trump claims the US will end its $4bn yearly military aid to Israel by the end of this year. Hoax bomb threats disrupt seven flights across Europe, and police arrest a person after a fire at a Mississippi police department tied to a toddler's fatal shooting.
